ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*powershell.*"))
